<style id="AUREL_R145_DARK_TEXT_CONTRAST">
/* R145 — tăng độ rõ chữ toàn bộ Dark Mode, không đổi bố cục/chức năng. */

body.aurel-dark-theme{
  color:#eaf4fb!important;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased!important;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing:grayscale!important;
  text-rendering:optimizeLegibility!important;
}

/* Tiêu đề và số liệu chính */
body.aurel-dark-theme :is(
  h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,strong,b,
  .title,.section-title,.panel-title,.card-title,
  .metric-value,.value,.big-value,.kpi-value,
  .topbar-title,.page-title
){
  color:#f8fbff!important;
  opacity:1!important;
}

/* Nội dung mô tả thông thường */
body.aurel-dark-theme :is(
  p,label,li,dt,dd,td,
  .description,.subtitle,.helper,.hint,.meta,.caption,
  .panel-subtitle,.card-subtitle,.field-label
):not([class*="positive"]):not([class*="negative"]):not([class*="success"]):not([class*="danger"]):not([class*="warning"]):not([class*="status"]):not([class*="trend"]){
  color:#d8e7f1!important;
  opacity:1!important;
}

/* Chữ phụ vốn đang quá chìm */
body.aurel-dark-theme :is(
  small,.muted,.text-muted,.secondary,.subtle,
  .eyebrow,.overline,.footnote,.note-text,
  .table-note,.unit,.timestamp
):not([class*="positive"]):not([class*="negative"]):not([class*="success"]):not([class*="danger"]):not([class*="warning"]):not([class*="status"]):not([class*="trend"]){
  color:#a9c1d2!important;
  opacity:1!important;
}

/* Điều hướng: sidebar, tab, menu */
body.aurel-dark-theme :is(
  #nav button,#nav a,
  .sidebar button,.sidebar a,.sidebar span,
  .nav-item,.nav-item span,
  .tab,.tabs button,.menu-item
){
  color:#eef7fd!important;
  opacity:1!important;
}

body.aurel-dark-theme :is(
  #nav button.active,#nav a.active,
  .nav-item.active,.tab.active,.tabs button.active
){
  color:#ffffff!important;
  font-weight:700!important;
}

/* Form controls */
body.aurel-dark-theme :is(input,select,textarea){
  color:#f2f8fc!important;
  caret-color:#7dd3fc!important;
}

body.aurel-dark-theme :is(input,textarea)::placeholder{
  color:#9fb8c9!important;
  opacity:1!important;
}

body.aurel-dark-theme option{
  color:#eef6fb!important;
  background:#111d2a!important;
}

/* Bảng */
body.aurel-dark-theme th{
  color:#dceaf3!important;
  opacity:1!important;
}

body.aurel-dark-theme td{
  color:#d6e5ef!important;
  opacity:1!important;
}

/* Các đường link văn bản thường */
body.aurel-dark-theme a:not(.nav-item):not([class*="button"]):not([class*="btn"]){
  color:#9ed7ff!important;
}

/* Nút mặc định, không đè màu trạng thái đặc biệt */
body.aurel-dark-theme button:not([class*="success"]):not([class*="danger"]):not([class*="warning"]):not([class*="status"]){
  text-shadow:none!important;
}

/* Một số vùng dashboard dùng opacity thấp cho chữ con */
body.aurel-dark-theme :is(
  .panel,.card,.metric,.monitor-card,.scenario-control,
  .analysis-feature,.ai-key-panel,.table-wrap
) :is(p,small,label,.muted,.meta,.caption,.subtitle,.description){
  opacity:1!important;
}

/* Mobile: vẫn sáng nhưng không gắt */
@media(max-width:700px){
  body.aurel-dark-theme :is(p,label,li,td,.description,.subtitle,.helper,.hint,.meta,.caption){
    color:#d3e3ee!important;
  }
  body.aurel-dark-theme :is(small,.muted,.text-muted,.secondary,.subtle,.footnote,.unit){
    color:#a4bdce!important;
  }
}
</style>
<style id="AUREL_R146_SUPPORT_OUTPUT_CONTRAST">
/* Chỉ tăng độ rõ phần nội dung phân tích ở trang Phân tích hỗ trợ, Dark Mode. */
body.aurel-dark-theme:has(#nav button[data-page="support"].active) :is(
  .panel,.ai-feature,.ai-connect,.analysis-result,.result-card,
  [class*="result"],[class*="summary"],[class*="output"]
) :is(p,li,dd,.content,.body,.text,.description,.summary,.analysis-text){
  color:#bfd3e1!important;
  opacity:1!important;
  font-weight:500!important;
  line-height:1.72!important;
  text-shadow:0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.05)!important;
}

/* Nếu đoạn phân tích được render trực tiếp bằng div/span thay vì p. */
body.aurel-dark-theme:has(#nav button[data-page="support"].active) :is(
  [class*="result"],[class*="summary"],[class*="output"]
) :is(div,span):not(
  .badge,.chip,.status-pill,.ai-key-status,.button,button,
  [class*="status"],[class*="badge"],[class*="chip"]
){
  color:#bfd3e1!important;
  opacity:1!important;
}

/* Tiêu đề kết quả giữ sáng rõ hơn nội dung. */
body.aurel-dark-theme:has(#nav button[data-page="support"].active) :is(
  [class*="result"],[class*="summary"],[class*="output"],.panel
) :is(h2,h3,h4,strong){
  color:#f5f9fc!important;
  opacity:1!important;
}

/* Giữ badge trạng thái như "Chờ duyệt" có màu riêng. */
body.aurel-dark-theme:has(#nav button[data-page="support"].active) :is(
  .badge,.chip,.status-pill,.ai-key-status,
  [class*="status"],[class*="badge"],[class*="chip"]
){
  opacity:1!important;
}
</style>
<style id="AUREL_R147_SUPPORT_SUMMARY_FORCE">
body.aurel-dark-theme .aurel-r147-summary-card{
  color:#d9e8f2!important;
}

body.aurel-dark-theme .aurel-r147-summary-card .aurel-r147-summary-text{
  color:#d3e4ef!important;
  opacity:1!important;
  font-weight:500!important;
  line-height:1.72!important;
  text-shadow:0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.06)!important;
}

body.aurel-dark-theme .aurel-r147-summary-card .aurel-r147-summary-title{
  color:#ffffff!important;
  opacity:1!important;
  font-weight:800!important;
}

body.aurel-dark-theme .aurel-r147-summary-card .aurel-r147-status{
  color:#ffd36a!important;
  opacity:1!important;
}
</style>
<script id="AUREL_R147_SUPPORT_SUMMARY_FORCE_JS">
(function(){
  function norm(v){
    return String(v||"").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim();
  }

  function visible(el){
    if(!el) return false;
    var r=el.getBoundingClientRect();
    return r.width>0 && r.height>0;
  }

  function findCard(titleEl){
    var cur=titleEl;
    for(var i=0;i<9 && cur && cur!==document.body;i++,cur=cur.parentElement){
      var r=cur.getBoundingClientRect();
      var t=norm(cur.textContent);
      if(r.width>=280 && r.height>=120 && r.height<=900 && t.length>=120 && t.length<=6000){
        return cur;
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  function apply(){
    if(!document.body.classList.contains("aurel-dark-theme")) return;

    document.querySelectorAll(".aurel-r147-summary-card").forEach(function(el){
      el.classList.remove("aurel-r147-summary-card");
    });

    var title=null;
    document.querySelectorAll("h1,h2,h3,h4,strong,b,div,span").forEach(function(el){
      if(title) return;
      if(!visible(el)) return;
      if(norm(el.textContent)==="Tóm tắt điều hành") title=el;
    });

    if(!title) return;

    var card=findCard(title);
    if(!card) return;

    card.classList.add("aurel-r147-summary-card");
    title.classList.add("aurel-r147-summary-title");
    title.style.setProperty("color","#ffffff","important");
    title.style.setProperty("opacity","1","important");

    var statusWords=["Chờ duyệt","Đã duyệt","Đang xử lý"];
    card.querySelectorAll("*").forEach(function(el){
      var t=norm(el.textContent);
      if(!t) return;

      if(statusWords.includes(t)){
        el.classList.add("aurel-r147-status");
        el.style.setProperty("color","#ffd36a","important");
        el.style.setProperty("opacity","1","important");
        return;
      }

      if(el===title) return;

      var childrenText=Array.from(el.children||[]).map(function(c){return norm(c.textContent)}).join(" ");
      var ownText=t;
      if(childrenText && childrenText===t) return;

      if(
        ownText.length>=35 ||
        ownText.startsWith("Trong năm") ||
        ownText.indexOf("VPB")>=0 ||
        ownText.indexOf("tỷ đồng")>=0
      ){
        el.classList.add("aurel-r147-summary-text");
        el.style.setProperty("color","#d3e4ef","important");
        el.style.setProperty("opacity","1","important");
        el.style.setProperty("font-weight","500","important");
        el.style.setProperty("line-height","1.72","important");
      }
    });
  }

  var queued=false;
  function schedule(){
    if(queued) return;
    queued=true;
    requestAnimationFrame(function(){
      queued=false;
      apply();
    });
  }

  if(document.readyState==="loading"){
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",schedule,{once:true});
  }else{
    schedule();
  }

  var root=document.getElementById("root")||document.body;
  new MutationObserver(schedule).observe(root,{
    childList:true,
    subtree:true,
    characterData:true,
    attributes:true,
    attributeFilter:["class"]
  });

  document.addEventListener("click",function(){
    setTimeout(apply,60);
  },true);
})();
</script>
<style id="AUREL_R148_SUPPORT_SUMMARY_WHITE">
body.aurel-dark-theme .aurel-r148-summary-card,
body.aurel-dark-theme .aurel-r148-summary-card p,
body.aurel-dark-theme .aurel-r148-summary-card li,
body.aurel-dark-theme .aurel-r148-summary-card dd,
body.aurel-dark-theme .aurel-r148-summary-card .aurel-r148-summary-text{
  color:#ffffff!important;
  opacity:1!important;
  font-weight:500!important;
  text-shadow:none!important;
}

body.aurel-dark-theme .aurel-r148-summary-card :is(h1,h2,h3,h4,strong,b),
body.aurel-dark-theme .aurel-r148-summary-title{
  color:#ffffff!important;
  opacity:1!important;
}

body.aurel-dark-theme .aurel-r148-status{
  color:#ffd36a!important;
  opacity:1!important;
}
</style>
<script id="AUREL_R148_SUPPORT_SUMMARY_WHITE_JS">
(function(){
  function norm(v){
    return String(v||"").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim();
  }

  function visible(el){
    if(!el) return false;
    var r=el.getBoundingClientRect();
    return r.width>0 && r.height>0;
  }

  function findSummaryCard(){
    var titleEls=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll("h1,h2,h3,h4,strong,b,div,span"));
    var title=titleEls.find(function(el){
      return visible(el) && norm(el.textContent)==="Tóm tắt điều hành";
    });
    if(!title) return null;

    var cur=title;
    for(var i=0;i<10 && cur && cur!==document.body;i++,cur=cur.parentElement){
      var t=norm(cur.textContent);
      var r=cur.getBoundingClientRect();
      if(
        r.width>=280 &&
        r.height>=140 &&
        r.height<=1200 &&
        t.indexOf("Tóm tắt điều hành")>=0 &&
        t.indexOf("Trong năm")>=0
      ){
        return {card:cur,title:title};
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  function paintWhite(el){
    if(!el) return;
    el.style.setProperty("color","#ffffff","important");
    el.style.setProperty("opacity","1","important");
    el.style.setProperty("font-weight","500","important");
  }

  function apply(){
    if(!document.body.classList.contains("aurel-dark-theme")) return;

    var found=findSummaryCard();
    if(!found) return;

    var card=found.card;
    var title=found.title;
    card.classList.add("aurel-r148-summary-card");
    title.classList.add("aurel-r148-summary-title");
    title.style.setProperty("color","#ffffff","important");
    title.style.setProperty("opacity","1","important");

    card.querySelectorAll("*").forEach(function(el){
      var t=norm(el.textContent);
      if(!t) return;

      if(
        t==="Chờ duyệt" ||
        t==="Đã duyệt" ||
        t==="Đang xử lý"
      ){
        el.classList.add("aurel-r148-status");
        el.style.setProperty("color","#ffd36a","important");
        el.style.setProperty("opacity","1","important");
        return;
      }

      if(el===title) return;

      if(
        t.startsWith("Trong năm") ||
        t.indexOf("VPB duy trì")>=0 ||
        t.indexOf("tổng tài sản")>=0 ||
        t.indexOf("dư nợ cho vay")>=0 ||
        t.length>=60
      ){
        el.classList.add("aurel-r148-summary-text");
        paintWhite(el);
      }
    });
  }

  var queued=false;
  function schedule(){
    if(queued) return;
    queued=true;
    requestAnimationFrame(function(){
      queued=false;
      apply();
    });
  }

  if(document.readyState==="loading"){
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",schedule,{once:true});
  }else{
    schedule();
  }

  var root=document.getElementById("root")||document.body;
  new MutationObserver(schedule).observe(root,{
    childList:true,
    subtree:true,
    characterData:true,
    attributes:true,
    attributeFilter:["class","style"]
  });

  document.addEventListener("click",function(){
    setTimeout(apply,60);
  },true);
})();
</script>
</body></html>

  opacity:1!important;
}

body.aurel-dark-theme .aurel-r148-status{
  color:#ffd36a!important;
  opacity:1!important;
}
</style>
<script id="AUREL_R148_SUPPORT_SUMMARY_WHITE_JS">
(function(){
  function norm(v){
    return String(v||"").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim();
  }

  function visible(el){
    if(!el) return false;
    var r=el.getBoundingClientRect();
    return r.width>0 && r.height>0;
  }

  function findSummaryCard(){
    var titleEls=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll("h1,h2,h3,h4,strong,b,div,span"));
    var title=titleEls.find(function(el){
      return visible(el) && norm(el.textContent)==="Tóm tắt điều hành";
    });
    if(!title) return null;

    var cur=title;
    for(var i=0;i<10 && cur && cur!==document.body;i++,cur=cur.parentElement){
      var t=norm(cur.textContent);
      var r=cur.getBoundingClientRect();
      if(
        r.width>=280 &&
        r.height>=140 &&
        r.height<=1200 &&
        t.indexOf("Tóm tắt điều hành")>=0 &&
        t.indexOf("Trong năm")>=0
      ){
        return {card:cur,title:title};
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  function paintWhite(el){
    if(!el) return;
    el.style.setProperty("color","#ffffff","important");
    el.style.setProperty("opacity","1","important");
    el.style.setProperty("font-weight","500","important");
  }

  function apply(){
    if(!document.body.classList.contains("aurel-dark-theme")) return;

    var found=findSummaryCard();
    if(!found) return;

    var card=found.card;
    var title=found.title;
    card.classList.add("aurel-r148-summary-card");
    title.classList.add("aurel-r148-summary-title");
    title.style.setProperty("color","#ffffff","important");
    title.style.setProperty("opacity","1","important");

    card.querySelectorAll("*").forEach(function(el){
      var t=norm(el.textContent);
      if(!t) return;

      if(
        t==="Chờ duyệt" ||
        t==="Đã duyệt" ||
        t==="Đang xử lý"
      ){
        el.classList.add("aurel-r148-status");
        el.style.setProperty("color","#ffd36a","important");
        el.style.setProperty("opacity","1","important");
        return;
      }

      if(el===title) return;

      if(
        t.startsWith("Trong năm") ||
        t.indexOf("VPB duy trì")>=0 ||
        t.indexOf("tổng tài sản")>=0 ||
        t.indexOf("dư nợ cho vay")>=0 ||
        t.length>=60
      ){
        el.classList.add("aurel-r148-summary-text");
        paintWhite(el);
      }
    });
  }

  var queued=false;
  function schedule(){
    if(queued) return;
    queued=true;
    requestAnimationFrame(function(){
      queued=false;
      apply();
    });
  }

  if(document.readyState==="loading"){
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",schedule,{once:true});
  }else{
    schedule();
  }

  var root=document.getElementById("root")||document.body;
  new MutationObserver(schedule).observe(root,{
    childList:true,
    subtree:true,
    characterData:true,
    attributes:true,
    attributeFilter:["class","style"]
  });

  document.addEventListener("click",function(){
    setTimeout(apply,60);
  },true);
})();
</script>
</body></html>

=== Tóm tắt điều hành #1 @ 1157056 ===
nav button,#nav a,
  .sidebar button,.sidebar a,.sidebar span,
  .nav-item,.nav-item span,
  .tab,.tabs button,.menu-item
){
  color:#eef7fd!important;
  opacity:1!important;
}

body.aurel-dark-theme :is(
  #nav button.active,#nav a.active,
  .nav-item.active,.tab.active,.tabs button.active
){
  color:#ffffff!important;
  font-weight:700!important;
}

/* Form controls */
body.aurel-dark-theme :is(input,select,textarea){
  color:#f2f8fc!important;
  caret-color:#7dd3fc!important;
}

body.aurel-dark-theme :is(input,textarea)::placeholder{
  color:#9fb8c9!important;
  opacity:1!important;
}

body.aurel-dark-theme option{
  color:#eef6fb!important;
  background:#111d2a!important;
}

/* Bảng */
body.aurel-dark-theme th{
  color:#dceaf3!important;
  opacity:1!important;
}

body.aurel-dark-theme td{
  color:#d6e5ef!important;
  opacity:1!important;
}

/* Các đường link văn bản thường */
body.aurel-dark-theme a:not(.nav-item):not([class*="button"]):not([class*="btn"]){
  color:#9ed7ff!important;
}

/* Nút mặc định, không đè màu trạng thái đặc biệt */
body.aurel-dark-theme button:not([class*="success"]):not([class*="danger"]):not([class*="warning"]):not([class*="status"]){
  text-shadow:none!important;
}

/* Một số vùng dashboard dùng opacity thấp cho chữ con */
body.aurel-dark-theme :is(
  .panel,.card,.metric,.monitor-card,.scenario-control,
  .analysis-feature,.ai-key-panel,.table-wrap
) :is(p,small,label,.muted,.meta,.caption,.subtitle,.description){
  opacity:1!important;
}

/* Mobile: vẫn sáng nhưng không gắt */
@media(max-width:700px){
  body.aurel-dark-theme :is(p,label,li,td,.description,.subtitle,.helper,.hint,.meta,.caption){
    color:#d3e3ee!important;
  }
  body.aurel-dark-theme :is(small,.muted,.text-muted,.secondary,.subtle,.footnote,.unit){
    color:#a4bdce!important;
  }
}
</style>

/* Chỉ tăng độ rõ phần nội dung phân tích ở trang Phân tích hỗ trợ, Dark Mode. */

      }
    });
  }

  var queued=false;
  function schedule(){
    if(queued) return;
    queued=true;
    requestAnimationFrame(function(){
      queued=false;

    });

      var t=norm(cur.textContent);
      if(r.width>=280 && r.height>=120 && r.height<=900 && t.length>=120 && t.length<=6000){
        return cur;
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  function apply(){
    if(!document.body.classList.contains("aurel-dark-theme")) return;

    document.querySelectorAll(".aurel-r147-summary-card").forEach(function(el){
      el.classList.remove("aurel-r147-summary-card");
    });

    var title=null;
    document.querySelectorAll("h1,h2,h3,h4,strong,b,div,span").forEach(function(el){
      if(title) return;
      if(!visible(el)) return;
      if(norm(el.textContent)==="Tóm tắt điều hành") title=el;
    });

    if(!title) return;

    var card=findCard(title);
    if(!card) return;

    card.classList.add("aurel-r147-summary-card");
    title.classList.add("aurel-r147-summary-title");
    title.style.setProperty("color","#ffffff","important");
    title.style.setProperty("opacity","1","important");

    var statusWords=["Chờ duyệt","Đã duyệt","Đang xử lý"];
    card.querySelectorAll("*").forEach(function(el){
      var t=norm(el.textContent);

      if(statusWords.includes(t)){
        el.classList.add("aurel-r147-status");
        el.style.setProperty("color","#ffd36a","important");
        el.style.setProperty("opacity","1","important");
        return;

      if(el===title) return;

      var childrenText=Array.from(el.children||[]).map(function(c){return norm(c.textContent)}).join(" ");
      var ownText=t;

      if(

        el.classList.add("aurel-r147-summary-text");

        el.style.setProperty("opacity","1","important");

body.aurel-dark-theme button:not([class*="success"]):not([class*="danger"]):not([class*="warning"]):not([class*="status"]){
  text-shadow:none!important;

/* Một số vùng dashboard dùng opacity thấp cho chữ con */

  .panel,.card,.metric,.monitor-card,.scenario-control,
  .analysis-feature,.ai-key-panel,.table-wrap
) :is(p,small,label,.muted,.meta,.caption,.subtitle,.description){

    color:#d3e3ee!important;

  color:#ffffff!important;
  opacity:1!important;
}

body.aurel-dark-theme .aurel-r148-status{
  color:#ffd36a!important;
  opacity:1!important;
}
</style>
<script id="AUREL_R148_SUPPORT_SUMMARY_WHITE_JS">
(function(){
  function norm(v){
    return String(v||"").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim();
  }

  function visible(el){
    if(!el) return false;
    var r=el.getBoundingClientRect();
    return r.width>0 && r.height>0;
  }

  function findSummaryCard(){
    var titleEls=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll("h1,h2,h3,h4,strong,b,div,span"));
    var title=titleEls.find(function(el){
      return visible(el) && norm(el.textContent)==="Tóm tắt điều hành";
    });
    if(!title) return null;

    var cur=title;
    for(var i=0;i<10 && cur && cur!==document.body;i++,cur=cur.parentElement){
      var t=norm(cur.textContent);
      var r=cur.getBoundingClientRect();
      if(
        r.width>=280 &&
        r.height>=140 &&
        r.height<=1200 &&
        t.indexOf("Tóm tắt điều hành")>=0 &&
        t.indexOf("Trong năm")>=0
      ){
        return {card:cur,title:title};
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  function paintWhite(el){
    if(!el) return;
    el.style.setProperty("color","#ffffff","important");
    el.style.setProperty("opacity","1","important");
    el.style.setProperty("font-weight","500","important");
  }

  function apply(){
    if(!document.body.classList.contains("aurel-dark-theme")) return;

    var found=findSummaryCard();
    if(!found) return;

    var card=found.card;
    var title=found.title;
    card.classList.add("aurel-r148-summary-card");
    title.classList.add("aurel-r148-summary-title");
    title.style.setProperty("color","#ffffff","important");
    title.style.setProperty("opacity","1","important");

    card.querySelectorAll("*").forEach(function(el){
      var t=norm(el.textContent);
      if(!t) return;

      if(
        t==="Chờ duyệt" ||
        t==="Đã duyệt" ||
        t==="Đang xử lý"
      ){
        el.classList.add("aurel-r148-status");
        el.style.setProperty("color","#ffd36a","important");
        el.style.setProperty("opacity","1","important");
        return;
      }

      if(el===title) return;

      if(
        t.startsWith("Trong năm") ||
        t.indexOf("VPB duy trì")>=0 ||
        t.indexOf("tổng tài sản")>=0 ||
        t.indexOf("dư nợ cho vay")>=0 ||
        t.length>=60
      ){
        el.classList.add("aurel-r148-summary-text");
        paintWhite(el);
      }
    });
  }

  var queued=false;
  function schedule(){
    if(queued) return;
    queued=true;
    requestAnimationFrame(function(){
      queued=false;
      apply();
    });
  }

  if(document.readyState==="loading"){
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",schedule,{once:true});
  }else{
    schedule();
  }

  var root=document.getElementById("root")||document.body;
  new MutationObserver(schedule).observe(root,{
    childList:true,
    subtree:true,
    characterData:true,
    attributes:true,
    attributeFilter:["class","style"]
  });

  document.addEventListener("click",function(){
    setTimeout(apply,60);
  },true);
})();
</script>
</body></html>

<script id="AUREL_R147_SUPPORT_SUMMARY_FORCE_JS">
(function(){
  function norm(v){
    return String(v||"").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim();
  }

  function visible(el){
    if(!el) return false;
    var r=el.getBoundingClientRect();
    return r.width>0 && r.height>0;
  }

  function findCard(titleEl){
    var cur=titleEl;
    for(var i=0;i<9 && cur && cur!==document.body;i++,cur=cur.parentElement){
      var r=cur.getBoundingClientRect();
      var t=norm(cur.textContent);
      if(r.width>=280 && r.height>=120 && r.height<=900 && t.length>=120 && t.length<=6000){
        return cur;
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  function apply(){
    if(!document.body.classList.contains("aurel-dark-theme")) return;

    document.querySelectorAll(".aurel-r147-summary-card").forEach(function(el){
      el.classList.remove("aurel-r147-summary-card");
    });

    var title=null;
    document.querySelectorAll("h1,h2,h3,h4,strong,b,div,span").forEach(function(el){
      if(title) return;
      if(!visible(el)) return;
      if(norm(el.textContent)==="Tóm tắt điều hành") title=el;
    });

    if(!title) return;

    var card=findCard(title);
    if(!card) return;

    card.classList.add("aurel-r147-summary-card");
    title.classList.add("aurel-r147-summary-title");
    title.style.setProperty("color","#ffffff","important");
    title.style.setProperty("opacity","1","important");

    var statusWords=["Chờ duyệt","Đã duyệt","Đang xử lý"];
    card.querySelectorAll("*").forEach(function(el){
      var t=norm(el.textContent);
      if(!t) return;

      if(statusWords.includes(t)){
        el.classList.add("aurel-r147-status");
        el.style.setProperty("color","#ffd36a","important");
        el.style.setProperty("opacity","1","important");
        return;
      }

      if(el===title) return;

      var childrenText=Array.from(el.children||[]).map(function(c){return norm(c.textContent)}).join(" ");
      var ownText=t;
      if(childrenText && childrenText===t) return;

      if(
        ownText.length>=35 ||
        ownText.startsWith("Trong năm") ||
        ownText.indexOf("VPB")>=0 ||
        ownText.indexOf("tỷ đồng")>=0
      ){
        el.classList.add("aurel-r147-summary-text");
        el.style.setProperty("color","#d3e4ef","important");
        el.style.setProperty("opacity","1","important");
        el.style.setProperty("font-weight","500","important");
        el.style.setProperty("line-height","1.72","important");
      }
    });
  }

  var queued=false;
  function schedule(){
    if(queued) return;
    queued=true;
    requestAnimationFrame(function(){
      queued=false;
      apply();
    });
  }

  if(document.readyState==="loading"){
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",schedule,{once:true});
  }else{
    schedule();
  }

  var root=document.getElementById("root")||document.body;
  new MutationObserver(schedule).observe(root,{
    childList:true,
    subtree:true,
    characterData:true,
    attributes:true,
    attributeFilter:["class"]
  });

  document.addEventListener("click",function(){
    setTimeout(apply,60);
  },true);
})();
</script>
